QuestInfo.name: The Second Act Begins
QuestInfo.0:
The forest has recovered its verdant appearance. 
However, the tree at the heart of your rebirth cycle has withered to a stump. 

It seems Penni has something to say.
QuestInfo.1: Penni asks how you're feeling. Tearful as you and Pan both are, you managed to smile.
QuestInfo.2:
You wiped your tears, dust off your clothes, and got up. 
Penni's wings will take you somewhere new.
